name: Bosco Labs Data (Free)
description: Hosted keyless endpoint of Bosco Labs Data, official-source records for AI agents with a source URL on every row. 4 tools, no authentication: lei_lookup (GLEIF), sec_company_lookup (ticker or name to SEC EDGAR CIK), plan_official_records_query and describe_official_records_tool. The same service has 30 more tools (SEC EDGAR, company registers, sanctions lists, EU and UK law) at https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp, which need an API key.
